name: turn1000_tie
purpose: The turn limit of every format (sim/battle.ts:1834-1843, before the Endless Battle Clause's rule check, so Reg M-C too): both sides switch both slots every turn (no PP, no damage, no draw: eight distinct Speeds), the warning lines appear from turn 500 (:1844-1852), and the battle ends as a tie when endTurn makes the turn 1001 (:1624, 1839-1842) without a |turn|1001 line.
